description: This file defines the BookManager class, which provides methods to manage book-related operations such as listing, searching, reserving, and deleting books within a library management system.

classes.name: BookManager
classes.description: A class that manages book operations such as listing, searching, reserving, and deleting books in the library system.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the BookManager with a Data Access Object (DAO) and sets up the Books model.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of books based on availability and optionally filtered by user ID.

methods.name: getReserverdBooksByUser
methods.description: Retrieves books reserved by a specific user.

methods.name: getBook
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific book by its ID.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches for books matching a keyword and availability status.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserves a book for a user.

methods.name: getUserBooks
methods.description: Retrieves all books associated with a specific user.

methods.name: getUserBooksCount
methods.description: Returns the count of books associated with a user.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a book by its ID.
